title: Aaloo Paratha
excerpt: Aaloo Paratha is my favorite thing to eat with my evening tea. The perfectly spiced potato filling nestled in between the buttery…

recipe.name: Aaloo Paratha
recipe.summary: Aaloo Paratha is my favorite thing to eat with my evening tea.
recipe.summary_plain: Aaloo Paratha is my favorite thing to eat with my evening tea.

items.name: aataa
items.text: 2 cups aataa, whole wheat chapatti flour

items.name: Water (I used about 3/4 cup but you need to add it slowly so that you only add enough to form a soft supple dough)
items.text: Water (I used about 3/4 cup but you need to add it slowly so that you only add enough to form a soft supple dough)

items.name: small bunch of finely chopped cilantro
items.text: 1 small bunch of finely chopped cilantro

steps.text: Put the aataa in the bowl of the stand mixer
steps.text_plain: Put the aataa in the bowl of the stand mixer

steps.text: Add your desired amount of salt and slowly add the water.
steps.text_plain: Add your desired amount of salt and slowly add the water.

steps.text: Add only enough water to form a supple and soft dough.
steps.text_plain: Add only enough water to form a supple and soft dough.

steps.text: Let it rest for at least 30 minutes
steps.text_plain: Let it rest for at least 30 minutes

steps.text: Wash and boil the potatoes till ready
steps.text_plain: Wash and boil the potatoes till ready

steps.text: Peel and coarsely mash the potatoes and set them aside.
steps.text_plain: Peel and coarsely mash the potatoes and set them aside.

steps.text: In a pan add about 3 tablespoons of oil and add your coarsely mashed potatoes and the spices and mix well.
steps.text_plain: In a pan add about 3 tablespoons of oil and add your coarsely mashed potatoes and the spices and mix well.

steps.text: Now add the chopped onions, green chilies and cilantro.
steps.text_plain: Now add the chopped onions, green chilies and cilantro.

steps.text: Now squeeze the lemon juice and mix well and taste. Adjust accordingly.
steps.text_plain: Now squeeze the lemon juice and mix well and taste. Adjust accordingly.

steps.text: Let it cool completely
steps.text_plain: Let it cool completely

steps.text: Now divide your dough into about 12 equal rounds.
steps.text_plain: Now divide your dough into about 12 equal rounds.

steps.text: Roll one round out slightly.
steps.text_plain: Roll one round out slightly.

steps.text: Fill it with about a heaped tablespoon of the potato filling.
steps.text_plain: Fill it with about a heaped tablespoon of the potato filling.

steps.text: Make it into somewhat of a pouch and seal it.
steps.text_plain: Make it into somewhat of a pouch and seal it.

steps.text: Gently roll it out and make sure to roll it out onto a floured surface.
steps.text_plain: Gently roll it out and make sure to roll it out onto a floured surface.

steps.text: Heat your tawaa (griddle)
steps.text_plain: Heat your tawaa (griddle)

steps.text: Add some oil and add the parathas to it.
steps.text_plain: Add some oil and add the parathas to it.

steps.text: In a minute or so flip it and now add a tsp of ghee all around it and on top of it
steps.text_plain: In a minute or so flip it and now add a tsp of ghee all around it and on top of it

steps.text: Cook till done on both sides.
steps.text_plain: Cook till done on both sides.

steps.text: Enjoy with some Raita or mint chutney.
steps.text_plain: Enjoy with some Raita or mint chutney.
